one_liner: ClickUp has a broad public REST API available on all plans (including free) with personal tokens and OAuth2, plus an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API token (pk_...) sent raw in Authorization header; OAuth2 authorization code flow for multi-user apps, Bearer token, access tokens currently don't expire. Workspace owner/admin creates OAuth app.
access_notes: API available on all plans including Free Forever. Rate limit 100 req/min per token on Free/Unlimited/Business; higher on Business Plus/Enterprise.
blocker_notes: Only minor friction: 100 req/min rate limit on lower plans; Whiteboards and Dashboards have no API.

evidence.quote: For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes. Personal tokens begin with `pk_`.
The ClickUp API is available on all [ClickUp plans](https://clickup.com/pricing).
ClickUp offers a documented public REST API at developer.clickup.com with personal tokens or OAuth 2.0 and native HMAC-signed webhooks.
